'''''Phalaris paradoxa''''' is a species of grass in genus ''[[Phalaris (plant)|Phalaris]]''. Common names include '''awned canary-grass'''<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007|accessdate=2014-10-17}}</ref> and '''hood canarygrass'''.<ref>{{PLANTS|id=PHPA5|taxon=Phalaris paradoxa|accessdate=24 September 2015}}</ref>

The spikelets are very different from those of other members of this genus.  The spikelet glumes each have a hook.

It is native to Africa, Asia, and Europe, and it has been [[introduced species|introduced]] widely. Its distribution within the [[United States]] includes Arizona, California, Hawaii, Louisiana, Maryland, New Jersey, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Washington.
